newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul stock market closed for new year holiday.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul stock market closed for new year holiday.

text.p: The Istanbul stock exchange was closed on Tuesday for an extended New Year holiday.
The Turkish central bank also announced half-day holidays in the money markets for December 31.
The central bank brokered Turkish Lira interbank will open between 0800 and 1200 GMT and the central bank brokered foreign exchange market will be open between 0800 and 1000 GMT on December 31.
